display.purpose: Short login headline only; keep the text brief.

label.purpose: Route identifiers, timestamps, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: surface-lift
shadows.purpose: Barely separate normal work surfaces from the page canvas.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: Give an active dialog clear priority over the workspace.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Small button, border, and surface feedback; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary next action in a delivery flow.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 43px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.39 0.075 232); color: white; font: 700 0.86rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.25 0.05 235); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.7 0.13 55 / 0.65); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action that preserves the working context.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 43px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.012 240); border-radius: 8px; background: white; color: oklch(0.24 0.035 240); font: 700 0.86rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.009 240); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.7 0.13 55 / 0.65); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A high-contrast field for operational identifiers and form data.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 45px; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.012 240); border-radius: 8px; background: white; color: oklch(0.24 0.035 240); font: 400 0.91rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.47 0.026 240); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.39 0.075 232); outline: 3px solid oklch(0.7 0.13 55 / 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Work Surface
components.description: Groups one route, search result, or evidence task.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.012 240); border-radius: 10px; background: white; color: oklch(0.24 0.035 240); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px oklch(0.24 0.035 240 / 0.025); font: 400 0.91rem/1.55 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface strong { font-weight: 700; } .ds-surface p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: oklch(0.47 0.026 240); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Pairs semantic color with explicit status text.
components.css: .ds-status-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 23px; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(0.95 0.03 155); color: oklch(0.43 0.09 158); font: 700 0.65rem/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-success:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.7 0.13 55 / 0.65); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Shows the current operational destination within the dark route rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 7px; color: oklch(0.86 0.018 220); font: 500 0.87rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item.ds-nav-active { background: oklch(0.35 0.055 232); color: white; } .ds-nav-item.ds-nav-active { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 oklch(0.69 0.16 55); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.7 0.13 55 / 0.65); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Route Progress
components.description: Shows resolved orders along the assigned route.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.88 0.012 240); } .ds-progress span { display: block; width: 50%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: oklch(0.69 0.16 55); transition: width 350ms ease-out; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress span { transition: none; } }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: Makes the stored-file state explicit before an authorized view action.
components.css: .ds-evidence-row { display: flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.012 240); color: oklch(0.24 0.035 240); font: 400 0.76rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-row .ds-file { font-weight: 650; } .ds-evidence-row .ds-status-success { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(0.95 0.03 155); color: oklch(0.43 0.09 158); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: A precise, reliable, direct interface for drivers and operations staff. Deep blue frames the workflow, amber signals route progress, and each order's outcome and evidence availability remain explicit. The ordered stop path is the signature visual device.
keyCharacteristics: Route and order states remain explicit and scannable.
Amber marks the next action or route progress; status colors communicate outcomes.
Evidence rows distinguish local previews, saved photos, and available private files.
The layout compresses to mobile without hiding the driver's primary actions.

rules.name: The Route Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber identifies route progress and the next meaningful action; it is not a substitute for semantic delivery, warning, or incident states.

rules.name: The Readable Route Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced text for codes and compact metadata only; recipient names, addresses, explanations, and actions stay in the sans-serif family.

rules.name: The Quiet Elevation Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary cards and panels flat-looking; reserve a pronounced shadow for a modal that temporarily owns focus.

dos: Do use Route Blue for primary actions and Deep Dispatch Blue for the persistent navigation frame.
Do reserve Signal Amber for route progress and the next meaningful action.
Do state whether a photo is a local preview, saved, or available before enabling a delivery outcome.
Do keep the route's sequence visible and preserve an explicit confirmation before closing the route.
Do keep keyboard focus, mobile actions, and reduced-motion behavior usable.
donts: Don't reuse Manifest's code, assets, or brand identity; it is only a visual and UX reference.
Don't reuse evidence-storage claims or labels to imply that a local preview is already private, saved, or available.
Don't use colored side stripes as card or alert decoration.
Don't add decorative numbered section markers; stop numbers are reserved for the actual route order.
Don't use heavy shadows on ordinary work surfaces or hide required actions at mobile widths.
